title: Dedicated capacity 1:1 + weekly prep (GPU pool forecasts & autoscaling)
content:
Purpose / context:
- Prep notes for 1:1 with Priya (capacity PM) and weekly dedicated-capacity sync. Focus: Q2 GPU reservations, short-term bursts for top customers, and autoscaling policy tweaks after last week's regressions.

Quick summary / headlines to surface:
- Current reserved pool: 128 A100s across us-west and eu-west (60/68 split). Average baseline utilization last 7d: 64% (us-west 71%, eu-west 57%).
- Forecast: increased steady-state demand expected for May (customer A onboarding + new feature rollout) => estimated additional steady need ~18 A100-equivalents. Peak bursts for demo days could add 40 GPU-hours/day for two weeks.
- Autoscale incidents: Tue 2026-03-02 saw failed scale-up due to quota check race (INF-5123). Need fallback policy and better retry backoff.
- Action ask: approve request to convert 20 A100s from on-demand to 12-month reservation in us-west (saves ~28% cost, keeps headroom for bursts with burst pool), or approve short-term reserved commit + burst credits.

Data to have on hand in the 1:1 / sync:
- last 14d utilization graphs (p95/p99 tail, mean GPU util) -> attach monitoring dashboard link (Confluence page above).
- per-customer top-of-pipeline forecast (A, B, C) with committed monthly tokens and expected spike windows.
- cost delta: on-demand vs 12mo reserved vs convertible reservations (rough numbers: on-demand $X/hr, 12mo reserved ~0.72*X).
- list of recent autoscale failures (INF-5123, DED-201) and short RCA bullets.

Discussion topics / agenda items:
1) Q2 reservation strategy (decision needed):
   - Option A: convert 20 A100s to 12mo reserved in us-west now (saves cost, reduces on-demand headroom).
   - Option B: purchase 12mo but keep a 30% buffer in dedicated on-demand pool for bursts (higher cost).
   - Option C: defer reservation, rely on autoscale + spot/burst credits for next 6 weeks.
   - My leaning: Option A + small burst credit pool (10-15 GPUs) to cover demo spikes.

2) Autoscaling reliability improvements:
   - Implement stronger quota-check retry logic (backoff + observable metrics).
   - Add fallback to cross-region routing when local scale-up fails (requires canary for latency impact).
   - Short-term mitigation: increase pre-warm threshold for known spike windows (customer A demo).

3) Metrics & SLOs to track after changes:
   - p95 latency for generate calls, GPU queue length, scale-up success rate, time-to-allocate.
   - Cost per 1M tokens served (after reservation) as a high-level KPI to report to finance.

4) Communication plan for customers:
   - For customer A: share planned reservation + pre-warm strategy to avoid demo regressions.
   - Internal postmortem + notes for on-call engineers about retry/backoff changes.

Open questions I want to ask Priya / sync team:
- Threshold for greenlighting reservations this quarter? (What signals does finance need?)
- Appetite for cross-region fallback vs increased latency risk?
- Can we use convertible reservations to maintain flexibility if forecast changes?

Action items (mine / follow-ups):
- [TODAY] Pull detailed 14d utilization broken out by model family and sequence length (Jordan) -> dashboard + csv for Priya.
- [THIS WEEK] Draft reservation proposal with cost delta + risk (Jordan + Finance) -> target by Fri 2026-03-06.
- [NEXT 2 WEEKS] Implement autoscale retry backoff patch (ENG-PR#187 reference) and add unit/integration tests (Samir).
- [PRIORITY] Create cross-region fallback runbook and experiment plan (Lina).
- [FOLLOW-UP] Notify CS for customer A pre-warm schedule and confirm demo dates (Priya / CS).

Notes / scratch ideas:
- Consider short-term burst pool purchased from cloud partner marketplace (cheaper than on-demand for <3 month bursts). Need procurement approval.
- Might prototype pre-warm by scheduling low-priority warm calls 30m before demo; measure cache hit improvements.
- If we buy reservations, consider staggering start dates across regions to avoid large one-time capital hit.

Useful references (links mentioned above):
- INF-5123: autoscale race condition (JIRA)
- DED-201: reservation pricing analysis (JIRA)
- Confluence: Dedicated Capacity Q2 Plan (link in metadata)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/187 (autoscale retry)

Prep checklist for the sync (quick):
- [ ] Attach utilization csv to meeting invite
- [ ] Confirm demo windows with CS for customer A
- [ ] Share draft reservation proposal with Priya before sync
- [ ] Ensure Samir has owner + estimate for autoscale fix

Meeting notes template (to capture during call):
- Decision: <reserve / defer / hybrid>
- Rationale: <cost, risk, customer impact>
- Owners & deadlines: <who, what, when>
- Follow-ups / comms: <what to tell CS/finance/customers>

Personal TODO after meeting:
- Update Q2 capacity spreadsheet (add reservation row + cost assumptions).
- Draft short email to execs summarizing cost impact if we proceed (run numbers for CFO).
- Book a 30m follow-up in 2 weeks to review utilization after any changes.

-- end of prep notes --
